_note: Every piece of art the game needs. refs = images (in art/) that fix the angle, shape and proportions; Klein restyles them. tiles = footprint width, used to size the result.
common: A single isometric game asset for a cozy farming game, seen from 30 degrees above and turned 45 degrees, matching the reference image's camera angle, outline, proportions and footprint exactly. Centered, complete and uncropped, isolated on a plain flat light grey (#e8e8e8) background with nothing else in the scene: no ground beyond its own footprint, no cast shadow on the background, no text, no border, no watermark.
